attributes.verification: REFUSAL, verbatim: `ValueError: instruction permutation region contains a control op`. WHAT FIRED: tools/gdl/webfrank.py permute_instruction_atoms, the per-atom loop that raises if `_is_control_instruction` holds for ANY atom in the region, before check_permutation_dependences is called at all. WHICH WORDS: `bl SetPlayerVars` at our +0x34 and `bl AllocMem` at our +0x48; both are inside the window and both must be, because the two moving atoms start before them and end after them, so no sub-window avoids them. WOULD A FINER CHECK PASS: yes. The two moving atoms are `li r29,0` and `li r26,0`. They read nothing, touch no memory, are non-control, and write only r29 and r26, which are NONVOLATILE under the PPC EABI -- a callee may not receive a value in them and must restore them, so no interposed call can observe or disturb either. The aligned view at 0x14:0x68 shows the intervening words touch r0, r3, r4, r24, r25, r27, r28, r30 and r31 and never r29 or r26, so there is no RAW, WAR or WAW hazard either. The calls themselves do not move relative to any non-moving atom. THE SOURCE SIDE IS EXHAUSTED, not the blocker: attempt.NM_additeminstlist-index-form-induction.20260903.v1 records five literal forms across both the initializer-position and induction-form mechanisms, establishing that holding the callee-saved ranking forces top-of-block emission (2 probes, real 4) and moving the emission to the preheader demotes `i` and the IV below the loop-invariant address hoists (3 probes, real 36 each, two of them byte-identical objects).

hypothesis.statement: A narrow, audited call-crossing mode for permute_instruction_atoms would close this: instead of refusing any region containing a control atom, refuse only when a MOVING atom crosses a control atom AND that atom is not provably transparent to the call. Transparency has a small, checkable definition -- the atom reads no resource, touches no memory, is itself non-control, and every register it writes is nonvolatile (r14-r31, f14-f31) -- and it is the same ABI argument webfrank already ships as `dominating_def_across_calls`, which lanes CT and LZ independently converged on rather than baking the assumption in silently. The control atoms themselves must additionally be required to keep their relative order and to move only by the displacement the non-crossing atoms impose.
